one_line: A calendar hook, one visible metaphor in a single take, and a message parents carry away.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on a wooden table: hands knead red clay; 0:01 an open palm with a clay ball. Voice (transcript) and subtitles from 0:01: "יום כיפור מתקרב", "ובתור מטפלת באמנות", then "חשבתי על דרך להמחיש לילדים...".
q1_hook.why: A calendar moment and a credential come in the first two seconds, said and written together (H1, H6, K7). Hands move from frame zero (E1). The promise, a way to show children forgiveness, is clear by 0:06 (H2). The first frame itself has no text and the headline builds over 3 s (T3).

beats.what: Hands shape a red clay disc into a heart; hook sentence builds in text
beats.why: Visible making while the promise is stated

beats.what: The Pongo by Giotto box of ten colour bars; "והפעם עם פלסטלינה"
beats.why: The product named in a 2 s insert

beats.what: A finger presses and crushes the heart; "כשילד פוגע... אי אפשר להחזיר את הרגע אחורה"
beats.why: The metaphor's low point, shown not told

beats.what: The crumpled heart is held; "אבל האם אפשר לתקן?" then "אפשר!" at 0:15
beats.why: A question and its answer inside 3 s

beats.what: Pink clay pressed into the cracks; "להכיר במה שקרה, לבקש סליחה"; "טעות לא הופכת ילד ל'ילד רע'"
beats.why: The repair, matched to each spoken step

beats.what: The patched heart turned in the hands; "גם אם נשארו בה סימנים, אפשר ליצור ממנה משהו חדש"
beats.why: Marks remain, a nuance on screen

beats.what: The repaired heart is held up to the lens; "אלא לדעת שיש לי את היכולת לתקן"
beats.why: The result and the last line together

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption makes statements only: no question, comment word, save, send or tag ask.
q2_flow.why: Heart made, crushed, repaired is a three-beat story with the payoff held to the end (K2, R4). The "האם אפשר לתקן? אפשר!" pair is a small loop (H5). The same hands and table throughout keep it clear, but 26 s are one take, so only the clay changes (R3, R1). 39 s suits one story (R2).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. The caption tells a story and ends on "בשיתוף ממומ@giotto_israel" (garbled as written). No link, question, save, send or comment ask, and no mention of where to buy.
q3_cta.why: No ask keeps the sell very light and the feeling intact (C7, C1). The cost is that a parent moved by it has no next step, and a message worth sending to a spouse or a gan teacher gets no send prompt (R5, C4).

q4_shown.what: Adult hands with light blue nails shape, crush and repair a red clay heart with pink clay; the Pongo by Giotto box of ten colour bars 0:07 to 0:09; the repaired heart held up at the end. No face, no child, no price.
q4_shown.why: The clay is handled from 0:00 and the before and after is the whole point (S1). The box shows for only about 2 s, a very light brand touch (H3, C7). Hands carry it, with no face (S4). The credential is stated in text at 0:02 (S6).

q5_edit.what: 5 shots in 39 s: cuts at 1.5, 7.3, 9.2 and 13.0 s, then one continuous take of about 26 s with zoom changes. No speed changes seen. Pink-and-white subtitles change with each phrase, voice wall to wall. Ends on the held-up heart.
q5_edit.why: A cut at 1.5 s opens with motion (E1). A 26 s single take is slow, but the clay changes constantly, so no dead air (E2, R1). Subtitles timed to the voice serve sound on and off (E4). It ends on the payoff, no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A Yom Kippur lesson for children about apology and repair, told with clay: a mistake does not make a child bad; serves a parent teaching forgiveness.
q6_topic.why: A timely, real parenting concern, delivered with warmth and no hype (K6, K7). A feeling and a visible story wrap the advice (K4). It builds to a warm, reflective peak, not a high-arousal one (K1). A line worth sending to another parent (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Phone looking straight down at a light wooden table in even daylight; adult hands only, light blue nails; close framing so the heart fills the frame; zoom or distance changes between 0:13 and 0:35; the heart lifted toward the lens at the end.
q7_filmed.why: A top-down hands-only frame is the first-choice format (F5, S4), and the heart fills it, so it reads on a phone (F4). Sharp, evenly lit, homemade (F7, F1). Lifting the heart toward the lens ends close and clear (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold rounded pink-and-white subtitles with a dark outline, no box, one to four lines, in the lower half: "יום כיפור מתקרב" (0:01), "ובתור מטפלת באמנות" (0:02), "אבל האם אפשר לתקן?" (0:13), "אפשר!" larger (0:15), "כמו הפלסטלינה" (0:25), "אלא לדעת שיש לי את היכולת לתקן" (0:36). No CTA.
q8_text.caption: "יום כיפור מתקרב וחשבתי איך להמחיש לילדים את המשמעות של סליחה והיכולת לתקן." About 68 words: why the clay, a reflection, the partner line last as "בשיתוף ממומ" (text cut off), the brand tag. No hashtags, no question.
q8_text.why: Subtitles follow the voice phrase by phrase and make it work muted (T1, T2, T3). They sit in the lower band that buttons and caption cover (T4). The first caption line is a keyword hook, with no hashtags (T7). The disclosure is garbled and last, so it is not clear at first view (T8).

weak_points: A garbled disclosure at the end of the caption; no ask or where to buy; subtitles in the lower band; the box appears for only about 2 s; no hashtags; a 26 s single take.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a single top-down take with one prop and one metaphor, name the calendar moment in the first second, and end on the finished object held to the lens.
not_verified: Whether the caption's last line reads "בשיתוף ממומן" (it shows "ממומ" then a tag). Music. Whether the account owner narrates. Whether there is a cut inside the 26 s take (the index finds none; zoom changes may hide a soft cut). No other corrections to the coded file.
